queries.title: Build daily revenue
queries.sql: INSERT INTO daily_revenue (day, revenue, orders_count) SELECT DATE(o.created_at) AS day, SUM(o.amount) AS revenue, COUNT(*) AS orders_count FROM orders o WHERE o.status = 'paid' GROUP BY DATE(o.created_at)

queries.title: Customer lifetime value
queries.sql: CREATE TABLE customer_ltv AS SELECT o.customer_id, SUM(o.amount) AS ltv FROM orders o JOIN customers c ON c.id = o.customer_id WHERE o.status = 'paid' GROUP BY o.customer_id

queries.title: Revenue by region
queries.sql: INSERT INTO revenue_by_region (region, day, revenue) SELECT c.region, DATE(o.created_at), SUM(o.amount) FROM orders o JOIN customers c ON c.id = o.customer_id WHERE o.status = 'paid' GROUP BY c.region, DATE(o.created_at)

queries.title: Executive net revenue KPIs
queries.sql: INSERT INTO exec_kpis (day, revenue, refunds, net_revenue) SELECT d.day, d.revenue, COALESCE(SUM(r.amount), 0), d.revenue - COALESCE(SUM(r.amount), 0) FROM daily_revenue d LEFT JOIN refunds r ON DATE(r.created_at) = d.day GROUP BY d.day, d.revenue

queries.title: Payment method mix
queries.sql: SELECT p.method, COUNT(*) AS n FROM payments p JOIN orders o ON o.id = p.order_id WHERE o.status = 'paid' GROUP BY p.method

queries.title: Churn risk customers
queries.sql: SELECT c.id, c.name, MAX(o.created_at) AS last_order FROM customers c LEFT JOIN orders o ON o.customer_id = c.id GROUP BY c.id, c.name HAVING MAX(o.created_at) < NOW() - INTERVAL '90 days'

queries.title: LTV segments
queries.sql: SELECT customer_id, ltv, CASE WHEN ltv > 1000 THEN 'gold' ELSE 'standard' END AS segment FROM customer_ltv
